def modify_features(X, history):
    F = pd.DataFrame(index=X.index)
    
    # Compute average purchase price for each customer in the last 180 days
    avg_price = history.loc[history['days_ago'] <= 180].groupby('customer_id')['price'].mean().reindex(X['customer_id'].unique()).fillna(0)
    F['f_avg_price'] = X['customer_id'].map(avg_price)
    
    # Compute average number of past purchases for each customer in the last 180 days
    past_purchases = history.loc[history['days_ago'] <= 180].groupby('customer_id')['days_ago'].count().reindex(X['customer_id'].unique()).fillna(0)
    F['f_past_purchases'] = X['customer_id'].map(past_purchases)
    
    # Compute average age of customers who made purchases in the last 180 days
    avg_age = history.loc[history['days_ago'] <= 180].groupby('customer_id')['customer_age'].mean().reindex(X['customer_id'].unique()).fillna(0)
    F['f_avg_age'] = X['customer_id'].map(avg_age)
    
    # Compute average purchase price per product category for each customer in the last 180 days
    avg_price_product_category = history.loc[history['days_ago'] <= 180].groupby(['customer_id', 'product_code'])['price'].mean().reset_index()
    avg_price_product_category = avg_price_product_category.pivot_table(index='customer_id', columns='product_code', aggfunc='mean').fillna(0)
    F = pd.merge(X, avg_price_product_category, left_index=True, right_index=True, validate='many_to_one')[['customer_id', 'article_id', 'raw_u_age', 'raw_u_fn', 'raw_u_active', 'raw_u_club_member_status', 'raw_u_fashion_news_frequency', 'raw_i_product_code', 'raw_i_product_type_no', 'raw_i_graphical_appearance_no', 'raw_i_colour_group_code', 'raw_i_perceived_colour_value_id', 'raw_i_perceived_colour_master_id', 'raw_i_department_no', 'raw_i_index_group_no', 'raw_i_section_no', 'raw_i_garment_group_no', 'f_avg_price', 'f_past_purchases', 'f_avg_age', 'f_avg_price_product_category']]
    
    return F[['f_avg_price', 'f_past_purchases', 'f_avg_age', 'f_avg_price_product_category']]
